# Suncly

> Suncly tests an A2A (Agent2Agent) agent against what its Agent Card claims and hands security and platform teams signed evidence: what passed, what failed, and what was never tested. A command-line tool in pilot; the hosted API is planned. It charges only for usage of its API (billing not live), and agents that meet its published criteria can carry the Suncly Certified badge, which links to the record behind it (programme opening with pilots).

Brand line: Evidence before access. Based in Tallinn, Estonia. Contact team@suncly.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://suncly.com/): what it does, how it works, how to install, evidence, use cases, Offer, Certified, Data, Research, Lab, what a pass does not cover.
- [Offer](https://suncly.com/offer): usage-only pricing, no seats, no plans; connecting and the badge are free; billing not live.
- [Certified](https://suncly.com/certified): the badge, its files and rules, the registry (empty at launch).
- [Data](https://suncly.com/data): what enters a test and what leaves it; the data inventory; deletion.
- [Research](https://suncly.com/research): notes on what evidence proves (drafts in review).
- [Lab](https://suncly.com/lab): the eleven mock agents, how to run them, the sample generator, an example contract.
- [Product](https://suncly.com/product): every capability with its status, and the comparison with manual review.
- [Sample evaluation](https://suncly.com/demo): one fictional agent, three real evaluations.
- [Security](https://suncly.com/security): what the tool touches, credentials, disclosure policy.
- [Docs](https://suncly.com/docs): getting started, command reference, evidence and reports.
- [Glossary](https://suncly.com/glossary): the terms, one sentence each.
